title: peering rate_limit.rs evicts fully-refilled buckets inside the current request's check()
description:
## What / Why
In crates/transit/src/peering/rate_limit.rs, PeerRateLimiter::check() evicts fully-refilled buckets via self.buckets.retain() on every call, after processing the current peer's article. This is O(n) in the number of tracked peers per article, where n grows under a high-fanout scenario.

## Fix
Same as the admin rate limiter: use a periodic sweep with a configurable eviction interval rather than running retain() on every call.
